input: Get a soil test done before planting season

gold.taskTitle: Get a Soil Test Done Before Planting Season
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to have their soil tested before the upcoming planting season to inform their gardening or farming decisions.

questions.title: What type of land are you testing — garden, lawn, or farm?
questions.description: Understand the scale and purpose of the land being tested.

questions.title: When exactly does your planting season begin?
questions.description: Identify the deadline so the task can be scheduled with enough lead time.

questions.title: Have you done a soil test on this land before?
questions.description: Determine if the user has prior experience with soil testing or baseline results to compare against.

questions.title: What specific plants or crops are you planning to grow?
questions.description: Different plants have different soil requirements, which affects what the test should measure.

questions.title: Do you prefer a DIY kit or a professional lab test?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred testing method to guide sourcing and next steps.

questions.title: How large is the area you need to test in square feet or acres?
questions.description: Determine the size of the area to understand how many samples need to be collected.

questions.title: Are there specific concerns like drainage, pH, or nutrient deficiency?
questions.description: Identify if the user has observed any existing soil problems that the test should focus on.
